body.name: \mathfrak R_{\varepsilon}
body.def: The rigid laws having a nonempty collection of incident atlas charts with \(\eta_{\chi}(\zeta)\ge\varepsilon\), identical target value and Jacobian across all such incident charts, distance at least \(\varepsilon\) from every incompatible chart closure, twice continuously differentiable chart extensions, and \(\lambda_{\min}(V_{\tau})\ge\varepsilon\).
